evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 夹镜鸣琴
evidence.excerpt_zh: 别有洞天迤西為夾鏡鳴琴南為聚逺樓東為廣育宫前建坊座後為凝祥殿宫東為南屏晚鐘又東度橋為西山入畫為山容水態夾鏡鳴琴之西為湖山在望為佳山水為洞裏長春（圓圓明園册）臣等謹按夾鏡鳴琴四十景之一額為皇上御書廣育宫奉碧霞元君殿額曰恩光仁照與西山入畫湖山在望佳山水洞裏長春諸額皆世宗御書廣育宫前坊額曰含𢎞光大曰品物咸亨與凝祥殿南屏晩鐘諸額皆皇上御書凝祥殿聫曰茂育恩覃昭聖感資生徳溥配坤元亦御書
evidence.summary: West of 别有洞天: 夾鏡鳴琴, with 聚逺樓, 廣育宫 (to 碧霞元君) and its arch and 凝祥殿, 南屏晚鐘, 西山入畫, 山容水態, 湖山在望, 佳山水 and 洞裏長春.

evidence.title: 广育宫 (S47 section 2.12)
evidence.summary: On a hill east of 夹镜鸣琴, in pines, facing north in its own court: a pailou, gate hall and the three-bay hip-and-gable main hall 凝祥殿 with side halls. Yellow tile on the album, rare among the shrines. Its goddess 碧霞元君 was prayed to for children; palace women crossed 福海 by boat to it, and a 过皇会 was held nearby on her birthday.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 3x1 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
